basic_profile.bio: Tech enthusiast and digital nomad based in Austin, Texas. I spend my days exploring the latest in cybersecurity and open-source software. A long-time fan of Lenovo and a devoted user of Waterfox and Firefox browsers. When I'm not diving into tech, you can find me enjoying live music events, especially when Post Malone is in town. Typically online during late-night hours, as I balance freelance tech consultancy with my love for gaming. Happily single and always on the lookout for the next adventure.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and years of self-taught expertise in cybersecurity, I have honed my skills through both formal education and practical experience working with diverse technologies. My passion for open-source projects keeps me engaged with communities like Waterfox and pwnagotchi.
